fato_historico: 1992: Thai Airways International Flight 311 crashes into a mountain north of Kathmandu, Nepal killing all 113 people on board.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to navigate complex terrain with grace. Just as a resilient mountain peak stands tall, consider how your own perspective shifts with the wind. It is a good time to reflect on the preciousness of every moment, perhaps finding beauty in the altitude of your thoughts and the depth of your connections.
frase_do_dia: Every mountain you face is a gateway to a higher view of yourself.
significado_numero: Represents transformation and the gentle rhythm of life's transitions.
conselho: Focus on the present and breathe deeply through your daily journey today.
